messages:
incident-bot: PAGER 1956794321: runtime.us-west2.high 11 KV cache growth anomaly detected (sustained rate > 5x baseline), p99 generation latency > 500ms, autoscaler thrash observed. Paging @oncall-quin.
oncall-quin: seeing the page, jumping in. any recent config flips?
eng-runtime-sam: FYI we enabled an experimental batching tweak `batching.allow_more_inflight=true` in canary at 2026-03-14T03:05 (roll id: rollout/2026-03-14-762). It increased concurrency but I didn't expect cache dedupe to regress.
sre-noah: metrics: model-y KV entries per pod spiked from 3M -> 25M across cluster in 10m. HPA scaled from 3 -> 12 then down to 2 repeatedly. attaching graph: <link to chart>.
oncall-quin: can we identify request shapes? run a prefix histogram and look for repeating client ids.
ml-ops-farah: running quick trace query: `traces | where model=="model-y" | summarize count() by prefix_hash | order by count desc` 1 top prefixes dominated by a test harness from partner-account/uat that loops with slightly different suffixes -> churn.
eng-runtime-sam: that matches suspicion: batching path lost identical-prefix dedupe under concurrent inflight. each concurrent inflight created a separate KV key variant.
oncall-quin: immediate actions: A) rollback experimental batching flag in prod canary and then prod, B) increase HPA scaleDown stabilization to 5m, C) deploy runtime env var `KV_MAX_PER_WORKER=15000` as temporary soft cap, D) notify affected customers. assign.
deploy-bot: rollback candidate: `runtime:v2026-03-13-658` available. pipeline shows canary update option.
eng-runtime-sam: I will kick the rollback to canary now. command: ``kubectl -n runtime set env deploy/runtime BATCHING_ALLOW_MORE_INFLIGHT=false --record`` then trigger rollout.
eng-runtime-sam: starting canary rollback, will watch telemetry for 2m then promote.
sre-noah: applying HPA patch: setting `spec.behavior.scaleDown.stabilizationWindowSeconds=300` and `metrics[].target.type=AverageValue` tweak to reduce noisy scale signals. patch applied.
ml-ops-farah: applying KV cap to canary pods via kustomize overlay, env `KV_MAX_PER_WORKER=15000`. small risk of increased misses but prevents OOM.
eng-runtime-sam: canary metric update: p99 -> 210ms from 580ms, KV insert rate dropping. canary HPA stable at 3 replicas.
oncall-quin: promote to remainder with 3-stage rollout across AZs, 90s pause per step. monitor for autoscaler events.
eng-runtime-sam: promoting stage 1 -> us-west2-b. pause 90s.
eng-runtime-sam: logs show repeated inserts for same logical prefix but with unique inflight tokens: ``kv: insert key="/model-y/pfx/0x9a-req-123"`` x2000. root cause confirmed dedupe off.
product-zoe: product note: some streaming assistants reported cut-off outputs and reconnect loops for ~8 minutes. major customers may have been affected.
customer-success-ellie: pulled support hits: partner-account reported 504s, two other midmarket accounts saw slow responses. I'm drafting customer comms.
sre-noah: after full rollout completed, cluster-wide p99 back to baseline ~180ms. HPA events quieted. KV total entries decreasing slowly toward baseline.
eng-runtime-sam: followups scheduled: revert experimental flag permanently until dedupe is restored, PR to add dedupe unit + integration tests.
ml-ops-farah: adding a regression eval that simulates concurrent similar prefixes and asserts KV growth < 2x. will add to pre-merge gating.
noncall-quin: runbook updates: add a checklist for batching flags that includes KV stress test and HPA impact review, default HPA scaleDown stabilization to 300s for runtime, and alerting on KV growth rate rather than absolute count.
product-zoe: request engineering to prepare a postmortem summary for customers (impact window, root cause, fixes, mitigations).
eng-runtime-sam: note: small hotfix applied to the dedupe codepath in a local branch, will open PR but revert remains the immediate production fix.
sre-noah: adding an alert suppression during deploys to avoid pages for expected transient KV spikes; will coordinate with deploy team to only suppress when `deploy.in_progress=true` metric is present.
customer-success-ellie: sent interim notice to affected customers, they requested ETA for full remediation. I'll link postmortem when available.
eng-runtime-sam: capturing logs and stack traces in #eng-runtime/incidents/1956794321 and attaching deployment diffs.
oncall-quin: handing off to daytime oncall @sre-noah for monitoring. summary: rollback executed, HPA hysteresis increased, per-worker KV cap added temporarily, customers notified. watch threshold: if KV growth rate >10% over 30m then page SRE.
sre-noah: ack, taking over. I'll run periodic checks for 6h.
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED 1956794720 1 severity downgraded to low.
customer-success-ellie: customers acknowledged improvement; partner-account confirmed degraded behavior resolved. closing tickets after 24h observation.
oncall-quin: thanks all. main takeaways: experimental batching concurrency needs stronger gating; KV dedupe must be protected under concurrency; HPA needs larger stabilization to avoid thrash. I'll file follow-ups: #PR-2102 (dedupe fix), #PR-2103 (CI regression), #DOC-402 (runbook). good job. :tada:
